description: Send a lossless FLAC audio file as base64 and get an MP3 back at 320, 256, 192 or 128 kbps CBR or audiophile VBR V0 / V2. Preserves Vorbis/ID3 metadata tags and embedded album cover art by default, with optional sample rate (44.1 / 48 kHz), stereo/mono and EBU R128 loudness normalization. Deterministic local ffmpeg (libmp3lame), 0 AI, nothing stored. Free: 5 calls/day per IP. Paid: Radar API key (from €9/mo at https://radarbg.com/pricing#starter via X-API-Key) or $0.005/call via x402 at https://radarbg.com/x402/flac-to-mp3.

fileContent.description: The .flac file as base64, max 20 MB (empty = built-in sample FLAC)

normalize.description: Normalize loudness to EBU R128 (-16 LUFS)

quality.description: MP3 bitrate or VBR preset: 320, v0, 256, 192 (default), v2, 128

sampleRate.description: Target sample rate in Hz, or keep original

stripMetadata.description: Strip ID3 tags and embedded album art

name: flac_to_mp3
title: FLAC to MP3 API - convert lossless FLAC to 320 kbps or VBR MP3 with tags
